parents.source: Geilen, Basten, Theelen and Otten, An Algebra of Pareto Points, revised and extended paper
read_locators: Section 4, Theorem 1 and Corollary 1, PDF page 8
parents.mechanism: Frontier sufficiency and dominance-preserving operations permit compositional Pareto minimization.
parents.mapping: Dualize smaller-is-better to larger-is-better; state actual domain guards for partial maps; retain preorder aliases until explicit representative selection.
parents.boundary: The cited source uses partial-order configuration spaces and its own well-ordered hypothesis. Do not conflate its extended-paper theorem numbering with the shorter ACSD2005 version, infer necessity of well-foundedness for a particular frontier, or claim every dominated configuration is irrelevant to nonmonotone goals.

parents.source: Doyen and Raskin, Antichain Algorithms for Finite Automata
read_locators: Section 2, PDF pages 3–4: preorders, quasi-antichains and simulations
Section 3.1, Lemmas 2–4 and Theorem 6, PDF pages 6–7
parents.mechanism: Simulation makes closed-set and promising-state pruning preserve reachability information. The source explicitly handles preorders and equivalent incomparable-class representatives.
parents.mapping: Use the declared preference orientation; restrict the all-same-word converse to deterministic partial transitions; compute the greatest simulation below a supplied base order and retain partial endpoint-observation guards.
parents.boundary: General nondeterministic trace-language equality does not imply forward simulation. The parent includes infinite-word applications under additional structure; V20 proves only its registered finite-word endpoint claim and makes no performance or infinite-run promotion.

parents.source: Mathlib mature primary implementation of well-founded order theory
parents.mechanism: Well-founded induction provides maximal elements after reversing strict order.
parents.mapping: Apply to the actual attained subtype and strict ascent relation; finite orders are a special case.
parents.boundary: The implementation is read as prior formal work, not imported into the Std-only kernel. Well-foundedness is sufficient, not necessary for cofinal maxima of one set; it does not bound frontier cardinality or give an effective infinite-input algorithm.

parents.source: Immutable V15 Context, admission and tagged partial evaluation
parents.mechanism: Ambient evaluator domain E is separate from admission P; actual values are obtained on P∩E.
parents.mapping: Construct selected attainable images and actual partial postcomposition, shrinking E by the successful Option domain while leaving P unchanged.
parents.boundary: Illegal ambient evaluations must not disappear by putting P into E; total V17 unchanged-domain transport cannot be imported for a partial map.

parents.source: Immutable V8 finite continuation machine and residual-budget lift
parents.mechanism: Explicit cost admission and subtraction on state×residual-budget product.
parents.mapping: Read actual lifted destinations as deterministic endpoint transitions; check the declared endpoint-value observation guard separately.
parents.boundary: Endpoint simulation does not preserve full EDGE/output/cost traces. Existing V8 nonempty constructor restrictions do not apply to the generic empty-state/action theorem.
